verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the platform under an open-source license is a fair question for a design tool, so the axis applies. Spline's evidence describes a cloud-hosted, browser-based editor where files live in the cloud, with nothing about self-hosting the editor itself or an open-source license. Its 'Self-Hosted' export packages a single project and the Spline runtime as a ZIP. That is a scene export, not the design platform, so it does not deliver this story.
